name: Theory of everything
summary: Is there a single coherent framework that unifies all fundamental interactions and explains all physical phenomena?
why_hard: Requires reconciling quantum field theory with general relativity and matching all low-energy data.

name: Dimensionless physical constants
summary: Can the dimensionless constants of nature (fine-structure constant, mass ratios, etc.) be derived from first principles, or are some historical/quantum accidents?
why_hard: No accepted principle selects observed values; may require multiverse/anthropic reasoning or a TOE.

name: Anthropic principle necessity
summary: Are important aspects of the universe only understandable via anthropic selection, or is the principle unnecessary/unscientific?
why_hard: Blurs physics and philosophy; hard to falsify cleanly.

name: Quantum gravity
summary: Can quantum mechanics and general relativity be realized as a fully consistent theory? Is spacetime continuous or discrete? Graviton-mediated or emergent?
why_hard: Planck-scale physics is experimentally almost inaccessible; multiple incomplete frameworks compete.

name: Black hole information paradox
summary: Do black holes radiate thermally as Hawking predicted? Does radiation encode interior information? What remains after evaporation?
why_hard: Tensions unitarity, locality, and semiclassical gravity in extreme regimes.

name: Hawking radiation confirmation
summary: Do real black holes emit Hawking radiation as predicted? Observable only for microscopic or analogue systems so far.
why_hard: Astrophysical Hawking temperatures are tiny; relies on analogues or future precision.

name: Cosmic censorship hypothesis
summary: Can naked singularities form from realistic initial conditions, or does nature always hide them behind horizons?
why_hard: Global nonlinear PDE analysis of Einstein equations under generic conditions.

name: Chronology protection conjecture
summary: Does quantum gravity forbid closed timelike curves / macroscopic time travel as Hawking suggested?
why_hard: Requires a complete quantum gravity theory of realistic spacetimes.

name: Holographic principle (general)
summary: Does quantum gravity admit a lower-dimensional dual without gravity? Can AdS/CFT be generalized to de Sitter and arbitrary asymptotics?
why_hard: Best understood only in AdS; our universe is approximately de Sitter.

name: Emergence of spacetime
summary: How does classical continuous spacetime emerge from discrete/quantum microphysics (LQG, entanglement in AdS/CFT, etc.)?
why_hard: No complete derivation of 4D classical GR dynamics from a unique microtheory of our universe.

name: Problem of time
summary: How to reconcile time as a universal background parameter in QM with dynamical spacetime in GR?
why_hard: Conceptual clash between two successful theories; multiple incompatible proposals.

name: M-theory fundamental degrees of freedom
summary: What are the fundamental degrees of freedom of M-theory, and does it describe Nature?
why_hard: No complete nonperturbative definition connected to unique low-energy physics.

name: Why 3+1 spacetime dimensions
summary: Why does the universe appear to have one time and three space dimensions?
why_hard: May be environmental; no unique dynamical selection principle established.

name: Yang–Mills existence and mass gap
summary: Prove existence of a nontrivial quantum Yang–Mills theory on R^4 with a mass gap (Clay Millennium Prize).
why_hard: Nonperturbative constructive QFT in 4D is extremely difficult.

name: Rigorous interacting 4D QFT
summary: Construct mathematically rigorous interacting quantum field theories in 4D spacetime without relying only on perturbation theory.
why_hard: UV divergences, renormalization, and nonperturbative control in 4D.

name: Color confinement (analytic proof)
summary: Provide an analytic proof that color-charged particles are confined in non-Abelian gauge theory / QCD.
why_hard: Nonperturbative strong-coupling dynamics without complete analytic tools.

name: Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness
summary: Do smooth solutions to 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes exist for all time for nice initial data, or do singularities form? (Clay Millennium)
why_hard: Nonlinear PDE blow-up control in 3D is a century-old challenge.

name: Statistical theory of turbulence
summary: Is there a closed theoretical model for the statistics and internal structures of turbulent flow?
why_hard: Strong nonlinearity, multiscale energy cascade, lack of closed equations for moments.

name: Nature of dark matter
summary: What is dark matter? WIMP, axion, sterile neutrino, primordial black holes, modified gravity, or something else?
why_hard: Only gravitational evidence so far; vast candidate space; null direct searches.

name: Nature of dark energy
summary: What causes the accelerated expansion of the universe? Cosmological constant, quintessence, modified gravity, or misinterpreted data?
why_hard: Equation of state near -1; many models fit current data.

name: Cosmological constant problem
summary: Why is vacuum energy density ~120 orders of magnitude smaller than naive QFT estimates? What cancels it?
why_hard: Worst fine-tuning problem in physics; no consensus mechanism.

name: Hubble tension
summary: Why do early-universe (CMB+ΛCDM) and late-universe (distance ladder) measurements of H0 disagree at high significance (~5σ)?
why_hard: Could be unknown systematics or new physics; hard to decide with current precision.

name: Matter–antimatter asymmetry
summary: Why is the observable universe dominated by matter rather than equal matter and antimatter?
why_hard: Requires Sakharov conditions; many mechanisms; need decisive experimental input (e.s. EDMs, CPV).

name: Cosmic inflation details
summary: Is inflation correct? What is the inflaton? Is inflation eternal? Are there viable alternatives?
why_hard: Many models fit CMB; need primordial B-modes or other decisive probes.

name: Horizon problem / alternatives
summary: Why is the distant universe so homogeneous? Is inflation the unique solution?
why_hard: Inflation is standard but not unique; alternatives hard to distinguish.

name: Cosmic coincidence problem
summary: Why are dark matter and dark energy densities comparable today despite different evolution?
why_hard: May be anthropic or dynamical coupling; underdetermined.

name: Origin and fate of the universe
summary: How did conditions for existence arise? Big Freeze, Rip, Crunch, or Bounce?
why_hard: Requires quantum gravity + true dark-energy dynamics into the far future.

name: Size, shape, and topology of the universe
summary: Is the universe infinite? What is the 3-manifold topology of comoving space?
why_hard: Beyond the particle horizon is unobservable in principle.

name: Cosmological principle validity
summary: Is the universe homogeneous and isotropic on large scales? Is FLRW the right metric? Is CMB dipole purely kinematic?
why_hard: Requires all-sky deep surveys free of systematics.

name: Extra dimensions
summary: Does nature have more than 4 spacetime dimensions? What size? Fundamental or emergent?
why_hard: No experimental signal; vast model space.

name: Dark flow
summary: Is there a bulk flow of galaxy clusters from gravitational pull outside the observable universe?
why_hard: Observationally disputed; needs better peculiar-velocity data.

name: Cosmological lithium problem
summary: Why does Big Bang nucleosynthesis overpredict 7Li relative to old stars?
why_hard: Tension between nuclear theory, stellar atmospheres, and observations.

name: Hierarchy problem
summary: Why is gravity so weak compared to other forces / why is the electroweak scale far below the Planck scale?
why_hard: Naturalness arguments failed at LHC so far; may need new philosophy of theory choice.

name: Strong CP problem
summary: Why is the QCD θ angle so tiny? Is Peccei–Quinn / axion the solution?
why_hard: Fine-tuning without new symmetry; axion searches ongoing.

name: Neutrino masses and nature
summary: Absolute neutrino mass scale? Dirac or Majorana? Normal or inverted hierarchy? CP phase? Sterile neutrinos?
why_hard: Requires β-decay, 0νββ, oscillation, and cosmology experiments.

name: Three generations of matter
summary: Why three generations of quarks and leptons? Can Yukawa couplings be derived from first principles?
why_hard: Flavor structure appears arbitrary; many models, few decisive tests.

name: Koide formula
summary: Why does a simple relation among charged lepton masses hold to high precision (Q≈2/3)?
why_hard: Could be accident; no accepted dynamical origin.

name: Proton decay
summary: Is the proton stable? If not, what is its lifetime and decay modes (GUT predictions)?
why_hard: Lifetimes >10^34 yr; needs megaton-scale detectors over decades.

name: Grand unification
summary: Do EM, weak, and strong forces unify at high energy? Under what symmetry?
why_hard: Needs proton decay or other smoking-gun signals near GUT scale.

name: Supersymmetry realization
summary: Is spacetime supersymmetry realized near the TeV scale? How is it broken? Is the LSP dark matter?
why_hard: No LHC discovery of superpartners so far; parameter space vast.

name: Magnetic monopoles
summary: Did magnetic monopoles exist in the early universe? Do any remain? Do they explain charge quantization?
why_hard: Extremely rare if any; searches null so far.

name: Muon anomalous magnetic moment
summary: Why does the experimental muon g−2 differ from some Standard Model predictions?
why_hard: Tension may be theory systematics or new physics—needs both better SM theory and data.

name: Neutron lifetime puzzle
summary: Why do bottle and beam measurements of the free neutron lifetime disagree?
why_hard: Subtle experimental systematics vs possible new physics.

name: Reactor antineutrino anomaly
summary: Why is measured reactor antineutrino flux ~6% below some predictions?
why_hard: Nuclear data uncertainties vs sterile neutrinos.

name: Gallium anomaly
summary: Why do gallium solar-neutrino calibration source experiments see a deficit?

name: Proton spin crisis
summary: How do quarks and gluons fully account for the proton's spin?
why_hard: Nonperturbative QCD structure of nucleons.

name: Exotic hadrons structure
summary: What combinations of quarks exist (pentaquarks, tetraquarks)? Tightly bound multiquarks or molecules?
why_hard: Many states; ambiguous binding mechanisms.

name: Glueballs
summary: Do pure-glue bound states (glueballs) exist in nature, and which observed mesons are they?
why_hard: Mix with ordinary mesons; hard experimental ID.

name: Strange matter stability
summary: Does strange quark matter exist? Is it stable at zero pressure? Strange stars?
why_hard: Nonperturbative QCD equation of state uncertainties.

name: QCD vacuum and nuclear complexity
summary: How does nonperturbative QCD produce complex nuclei and nuclear structure from quarks and gluons?
why_hard: Multi-scale many-body problem from QCD to nuclei.

name: μ problem in SUSY
summary: Why is the supersymmetric μ parameter of the electroweak scale rather than Planck scale?
why_hard: Model-building within SUSY frameworks; depends on SUSY existing.

name: Solar coronal heating problem
summary: Why is the Sun's corona much hotter than its surface? Why is magnetic reconnection so fast?
why_hard: Multi-scale plasma physics from photosphere to corona.

name: Solar cycle and dynamos
summary: How does the Sun generate its reversing large-scale magnetic field? What causes grand minima like Maunder?

name: Astrophysical jets and QPOs
summary: Why do some accretion disks launch relativistic jets? What sets QPO frequencies and overtones?

name: Diffuse interstellar bands
summary: What molecules or materials cause the numerous unidentified interstellar absorption bands?

name: Supermassive black hole origins
summary: How did early quasars grow SMBHs to ~10^10 M☉ so quickly? Origin of M–σ relation?
why_hard: Needs early-universe growth channels constrained by deep surveys.

name: Kuiper cliff
summary: Why does Kuiper belt object density drop sharply beyond ~50 AU?

name: Flyby anomaly
summary: Why do some Earth flybys show tiny unexpected energy changes?

name: Galaxy rotation problem
summary: Are flat rotation curves due to dark matter, modified gravity, or both?
why_hard: Entangled with DM identity; multi-probe tests needed.

name: Core-collapse supernova mechanism
summary: What exact mechanism turns stellar core collapse into a successful explosion?

name: Origin of p-nuclei
summary: What astrophysical process produces rare proton-rich isotopes (p-nuclei)?

name: Ultra-high-energy cosmic rays
summary: What sources accelerate particles above the GZK limit region, and how?
why_hard: Rare events; composition and source ID incomplete.

name: Saturn deep rotation rate
summary: What is the true rotation rate of Saturn's deep interior given magnetospheric period puzzles?

name: Magnetar magnetic field origin
summary: What is the origin of magnetars' extreme magnetic fields?

name: Large-scale cosmic anisotropy
summary: Do radio/CMB/quasar polarization anomalies indicate large-scale anisotropy violating the cosmological principle?

name: Ultraluminous X-ray sources
summary: What powers ULXs exceeding Eddington limits—IMBHs, beamed neutron stars, or both?

name: Fast radio bursts
summary: What causes millisecond radio bursts from distant galaxies? Why do some repeat?

name: Origin of cosmic magnetic fields
summary: How were large-scale magnetic fields generated from galaxies to clusters?
why_hard: Primordial seed vs dynamo amplification hard to disentangle uniquely.

name: Galactic age–metallicity relation
summary: Is there a universal age–metallicity relation in thin/thick Galactic disks?

name: Quark–gluon plasma onset and properties
summary: Where is deconfinement onset in T–μ space? Why ideal flow? Flavor equilibration? Perfect statistical hadronization?

name: Nature of the nuclear force from QCD
summary: What is the precise nature of the nuclear force binding nuclei, rooted in QCD?

name: EMC effect
summary: Why do quark distributions in bound nucleons differ from free nucleons?

name: Neutron star dense matter EOS
summary: What is the equation of state of ultra-dense nuclear matter in neutron stars?
why_hard: Needs multimessenger GW + X-ray + nuclear theory.

name: Heaviest possible chemical element
summary: What is the heaviest element that can exist (island of stability limits)?

name: Color glass condensate / gluon saturation
summary: Do gluons saturate into a color glass condensate? What are decisive experimental signatures?

name: High-temperature superconductivity mechanism
summary: What mechanism causes high-Tc superconductivity in cuprates and related materials? Is room-temperature ambient SC possible?
why_hard: Strong correlations; many competing orders; materials complexity.

name: Glass transition
summary: What is the nature of the glass transition and universal properties of amorphous solids?
why_hard: No consensus thermodynamic vs kinetic theory of the transition.

name: Low-T amorphous solid universality
summary: Why is the phonon wavelength to mean-free-path ratio nearly universal across disordered solids?

name: Fractional quantum Hall ν=5/2 state
summary: What is the mechanism of the 5/2 FQHE state? Non-Abelian anyons?

name: Topological order at finite temperature
summary: Is topological order stable at T>0? Can 3D self-correcting quantum memory exist?

name: Sonoluminescence mechanism
summary: What causes light flashes from sound-driven imploding bubbles?

name: Metal whiskering
summary: What is the growth mechanism of spontaneous metal whiskers causing electronics failures?

name: Gauge block wringing
summary: What mechanism allows precision gauge blocks to wring together?

name: Helium-4 superfluid critical exponent α
summary: Explain discrepancy between experimental and theoretical heat-capacity critical exponent α near the lambda point.

name: Cryogenic electron emission anomaly
summary: Why does dark electron emission in photomultipliers increase as temperature decreases?

name: Quantum-dot energy-size nonparabolicity
summary: What causes nonparabolicity of the lowest optical absorption vs size in semiconductor nanocrystals?

name: Nematic–smectic-A transition universality
summary: Can the nematic to smectic-A transition be characterized as a universal phase transition?

name: Scharnhorst effect
summary: Can light travel slightly faster than c between closely spaced conducting plates via Casimir vacuum modification?

name: Granular convection / Brazil-nut effect
summary: Why do shaken granular materials convect and size-segregate?

name: Fault-tolerant quantum computing scalability
summary: Can we go beyond NISQ to fault-tolerant scalable quantum computers with practical error correction?
why_hard: Requires qubit quality, scale, and systems engineering.

name: Topological qubits / Majorana modes
summary: Can topological quantum computers be built? Can Majorana zero modes be demonstrated conclusively?
why_hard: Fabrication + unambiguous experimental signatures.

name: Non-cryogenic quantum computing
summary: Can useful quantum computing operate at non-cryogenic / room temperature?

name: BQP vs BPP / NP relations
summary: What is the precise relation of BQP to classical complexity classes? Can physical computation exceed BQP?

name: Post-quantum cryptography proofs
summary: Can we prove that specific cryptographic protocols remain secure against quantum adversaries?

name: Quantum channel capacity
summary: What is the quantum capacity of general quantum channels (often unknown in closed form)?

name: Fusion plasma confinement / H-mode
summary: Can plasmas be confined long enough and hot enough for practical fusion power? What is the physical origin of H-mode?
why_hard: Turbulence, stability, materials, and systems integration.

name: Fermi acceleration injection problem
summary: What pre-accelerates particles enough for Fermi acceleration to take over in astrophysical shocks?

name: Alfvénic turbulence
summary: How does MHD/Alfvénic turbulence work in solar wind, flares, CMEs, and substorms?

name: Ball lightning
summary: What is the physical nature of ball lightning?
why_hard: Rare, poorly documented events; many candidate mechanisms.

name: Abiogenesis
summary: Can life arise from purely physical/chemical processes? What pathway produced life on Earth?
why_hard: Historical path underdetermined; vast chemical space.

name: Homochirality origin
summary: Why do biomolecules prefer specific enantiomers?

name: Magnetoreception mechanism
summary: How do animals (e.g. migratory birds) sense Earth's magnetic field?

name: Gene expression noise and developmental robustness
summary: How do genetic networks remain robust under external pressure and internal stochasticity, especially in development?

name: Quantitative immune system networks
summary: What are quantitative building blocks and network properties of immune responses?

name: Protein folding physics (beyond structure prediction)
summary: How do proteins fold so fast? Are native states global free-energy minima? How do cells avoid precipitation at high density?

name: Quantum biology functional coherence
summary: Can quantum coherence persist long enough to be functionally important in warm, wet biology?

name: Biology from fundamental physical laws
summary: Can biology be expressed via fundamental laws, action principles, and symmetries (robustness, modularity, evolvability)?
why_hard: Enormous hierarchical complexity; unclear if unique reduction exists.

name: Interpretation of quantum mechanics / measurement problem
summary: How does the quantum formalism give rise to definite outcomes? What is a measurement? Which of locality/causality/realism must be sacrificed?
why_hard: Multiple empirically equivalent interpretations; may not have unique scientific answer.

name: Arrow of time
summary: Why does time have a direction? Why was the early universe low entropy? How do thermodynamic, cosmological, and quantum arrows relate?
why_hard: Tied to cosmological initial conditions; deep and possibly anthropic.

name: Nature of quantum non-locality
summary: Are non-local phenomena limited to Bell entanglement, or can information/conserved quantities move non-locally? Implications for spacetime structure?
why_hard: Constrained by no-signaling but conceptually unsettled.

name: Quantum mind
summary: Do quantum phenomena play an essential role in brain function and consciousness?
why_hard: Highly speculative; lacks decisive experimental support.

name: Geometric Langlands and physics
summary: Can the Langlands program explain physical symmetries and vice versa?
